messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic M. 40T is $799, Batch 5, ships November 14, 2026 — best value per TH we sell; power runs roughly $10 a month at 10¢.

Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Under twelve cents, that's a good rate for mining. Give me a second and I'll run the Magic M. 40T at that price. Roughly what do you pay, ten, eleven? If you want to answer out loud, tap the mic, or just listen.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T at 10¢: stacks ~57,500 sats a month (~$48), power ~$47 a month, block odds about 0.22% a year — first-miner pick, $799.
